title: Compiler driver: text to checked book as one first-error composition
reading_hypothesis: Tokenize, parse and check read as one bind chain with the IO continuation outermost; the unchanged stages are opaque interfaces, so the figure is judged on the composition it actually owns.

interfaces.name: S.Error
interfaces.signature: type Error is Data: Invalid{phase,code,at} | Unsupported{phase,code,at} | Exhausted{phase,at} | Internal{phase,code} | Host{phase,code}
interfaces.note: Shared error datatype; first failure propagates unchanged.

interfaces.name: S.Token
interfaces.signature: type Token is Data: Token{text: String, at: At}

interfaces.name: S.bind
interfaces.signature: def bind(-A: Data, -B: Data, result: Result<Error,A>, next: A -> Result<Error,B>) -> Result<Error,B>

interfaces.name: C.Book
interfaces.signature: type Book is Data: Book{types: List<&2,Datatype>, functions: List<&2,Function>}

interfaces.name: L.tokenize
interfaces.signature: def tokenize(fuel: Nat, input: String) -> Result<S.Error,List<&2,S.Token>>

interfaces.name: P.Parsed
interfaces.signature: type Parsed is Data: Parsed{value: S.Node, rest: List<&2,S.Token>}

interfaces.name: P.parse
interfaces.signature: def parse(depth: Nat, tokens: List<&2,S.Token>) -> Result<S.Error,Parsed>

interfaces.name: K.check
interfaces.signature: def check(depth: Nat, root: S.Node) -> Result<S.Error,C.Book>
